catalog = {}
with open(CATALOG_CSV) as f:
    r = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        catalog[row['timeseries_id']] = row

tsid = "7a9e6dea-7214-57d7-a3ab-6fec741ab22a"
print("Catalog entry:", catalog.get(tsid))

values = []
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        if row['timeseries_id'] == tsid and row['timestamp'].startswith("2018-04-08"):
            values.append((row['timestamp'], float(row['value'])))

values.sort()
print("Number of values:", len(values))
print("values:", values)
all_at_or_below = all(v <= 25.0 for _, v in values)
print("all at or below 25:", all_at_or_below)
print("max:", max(v for _, v in values) if values else None)
print("any > 25:", [(t,v) for t,v in values if v > 25.0])
